title: GUARD (fixed in db058fbede) — was: `_describe -o` under `prefix-hidden`: zsh lists `--bb` as bare `bb`, zshrs listed `bb-- same`

spec.completer:
#compdef fzc0000
zstyle ':completion:*:options' prefix-hidden true
zstyle ':completion:*' list-grouped false
local -a _m
_m=( '--aa:same' '--bb:same' '--cc:other' )
_describe -o hdr _m

retired.fix_commit_subject: completions: add the arguments builtin handlers accept but completers missed (carries the unrelated cd_get hunk; see why_this_fixture_exists)
retired.why: cd_get's CRT_DESC arm (src/ported/zle/computil.rs) now honours C's `p += str->len` (Src/Zle/computil.c:675): when the hide strip left str shorter than len, the display is the stripped name alone, as ztrdup(buf) at c:718 yields in zsh.
retired.evidence: compsys_spec_fuzz --replay: FAIL (3 row(s) differ) on the pre-fix copy, PASS on the fixed copy; compsys_regressions.py --only on each, see guard_verified.
retired.kept_because: a fixed bug is worth more as a guard than as a deleted file.

observed.measured: 2026-10-28, a copy of target/debug/zshrs built from db058fbede plus the cd_get fix (zshrs 0.13.56, 133994840 bytes, sha256 2eef4bc952208aa3) vs zsh 5.9.2, scripts/compsys_spec_fuzz.py --replay
observed.notes: With prefix-hidden, compdescribe -I strips the leading `--` from each cdstr's display string at Src/Zle/computil.c:559-567, AFTER str->len was measured at c:540. The CRT_DESC arm of cd_get then does `strcpy(p, str->str); p += str->len;` (c:674-675): the cursor steps past the NUL strcpy wrote, the padding, separator and description land after it, and `ztrdup(buf)` (c:718) keeps only the stripped name. zsh therefore lists `bb`, with no description. list-grouped false forces the CRT_DESC arm for every row.

observed_when_diverging.recorded_under: copy of target/debug/zshrs at db058fbede before the fix (zshrs 0.13.56, 133988872 bytes, sha256 358b8bcef8cf2bed)

guard_verified.against: pre-fix debug build (zshrs 0.13.56, 133988872 bytes, sha256 358b8bcef8cf2bed) — carries the bug
guard_verified.note: `python3.14 scripts/compsys_regressions.py --only describe_prefix_hidden_drops_description --zshrs <pre-fix copy>` exit 1 with the same detail observed_when_diverging records; the same command against the fixed copy (sha256 2eef4bc952208aa3) exit 0, both cells CONTROL-HOLDS. The two ERROR attempts were load (real zsh disagreed with itself between runs), re-run by --confirm-moved.

why_this_fixture_exists: The port computed padding from the stale width and appended separator and description, which C never shows. Found by hand-probing the `_describe -o` surface in the values/describe fuzz lane; the generator does not emit the prefix-hidden style. The cd_get hunk (src/ported/zle/computil.rs, the `p += str->len` arm) landed inside db058fbede, a concurrent commit on main that picked up the staged index; that commit's subject does not describe it.

controls.note: same completer without prefix-hidden: no strip, str->len matches the string, and both shells list `--aa  -- same` rows. Pins that the fix only fires when len outruns the stripped string.
